name: Creamy Chicken-Asparagus Skillet with Spinach, Jalapeño & Cheddar

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small bunch asparagus
1 jalapeño pepper
1 (5 oz) pkg baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: Preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the chicken dry with paper towels and medium dice.
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until golden and cooked through, 4-5 minutes. Remove to a plate. (Reserve skillet with drippings for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, snap (or cut) off woody ends of the asparagus; cut spears into 2-inch long pieces. Place in a small bowl.

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Small dice and add to the bowl with the asparagus. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)

Return skillet (with drippings) to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add asparagus, jalapeño, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until asparagus is tender, 3-4 minutes. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp onion powder
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, preheat oven to broil on high and position the rack in the upper third of the oven.
Coarsely grate cheese. Place in the reserved bowl and set aside.
Cut cream cheese into small pieces.
When the veggies are tender, add cream cheese, milk, and additional salt to the skillet. Cook, stirring constantly, until cream cheese is melted and sauce is combined, about 1 minute.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 fl oz (½ cup) whole milk
salt

instructions.primary_message: Add spinach to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for it to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Return chicken (with any accumulated juices) to the skillet and stir to combine. Remove from heat.
Sprinkle cheese over the skillet, then place in the oven and broil until cheese is melted and golden, 2-3 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide chicken skillet between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
